title: Gummi round5: editor ownership, camera and history semantics
status: Research only; no product code, IDB mutation, game process access, UI automation or save changes.
original_path: E:\SteamLibrary\steamapps\common\KINGDOM HEARTS -HD 1.5+2.5 ReMIX-\KINGDOM HEARTS II FINAL MIX.exe

claims.Finding: Initializes a Gummi menu scheduler at AF9F08 and module-state+8; registers the initialization fiber244230 in group0, priority1000. The teardown branch clears subsystem state and schedules removal of all current menu tasks.
claims.Limitations: Scheduler/global existence alone cannot distinguish initialized editor state from setup or teardown. Static analysis; no live execution.

claims.Finding: The Gummi menu initialization fiber loads menu resources, installs recurring tasks and allocates a1414672-byte WORKAREA. It invokes25DCD0(workarea,2,43400) and attaches the resulting object to AF9F08 through2646C0.
claims.Limitations: This function yields repeatedly via150060/39D460 and is not a synchronous external entrypoint. Static analysis; no live execution.

claims.Finding: Menu shutdown clears AF9FA0, drops the VM bank, removes tasks from AF9F08 and releases subsystems. The scheduler global is not nulled here.
claims.Limitations: A nonnull AF9F08 is not a lifetime proof; validate current scheduler/task ownership. Static analysis; no live execution.

claims.Finding: Constructs WORKAREA with vtable5B7330, inline GRID+128 and four HISTORY objects at+6256 with stride352064. It destroys a previous AFBEF0 before publishing the new object; owner group/priority are stored at+1414624/+1414628.
claims.Limitations: Constructor initializes global ownership but later editor setup establishes grid, cursor and camera links. Static analysis; no live execution.

claims.Finding: WORKAREA destruction releases its allocated grid buffers, clears global AFBEF0, destroys four inline histories and the grid.
claims.Limitations: Even valid-looking old grid buffers must not survive this destructor. Static analysis; no live execution.

claims.Finding: The deleting WORKAREA destructor performs the same owned-buffer/history teardown and conditionally frees the1414672-byte object through the Gummi menu allocator.
claims.Limitations: Deleting flags and allocator availability are native caller invariants. Static analysis; no live execution.

claims.Finding: Creates the WORKAREA task from stored group/priority: callback25E190, userdata+24=workarea, cleanup+104=25E1A0.
claims.Limitations: The task carries the native ownership proof; do not create a duplicate task. Static analysis; no live execution.

claims.Finding: WORKAREA recurring callback passes task userdata+24 to263840.
claims.Limitations: The downstream render/update routine was not independently recaptured for a trainer entrypoint. Static analysis; no live execution.

claims.Finding: WORKAREA task cleanup invokes userdata's deleting destructor withEDX=1.
claims.Limitations: Any task disappearance invalidates cached workarea pointers. Static analysis; no live execution.

claims.Finding: EDITBASE constructor sets active byte+8, initializes its embedded widgets, publishes AFC118 and initializes material/decor mode+12272=1 and editor phase+12276=0.
claims.Limitations: AFC118 is published before the editor fiber finishes setup; phase and task checks are required. Static analysis; no live execution.

claims.Finding: EDITBASE deletion clears AFC118, tears down embedded widgets, changes the vtable to MENUBASE and frees12336 bytes when requested.
claims.Limitations: AFC118 clearing is a destruction signal, not the only possible indication of an in-progress exit. Static analysis; no live execution.

claims.Finding: Creates a12336-byte GUMIEDIT with vtable5B78D0, part limit+12292=300 and main-ship flagAFC0C0=0; schedules it through274540 and stores the input plan at+12216.
claims.Limitations: The limit is a native editor field; changing it alone would not validate cost, grids or serialized plan capacity. Static analysis; no live execution.

claims.Finding: Creates the corresponding TINYEDIT with vtable5B7920, part limit64 and AFC0C0=1; ownership and plan setup match GUMIEDIT.
claims.Limitations: Companion/editor geometry differs; do not treat the main-ship limit as universal. Static analysis; no live execution.

claims.Finding: Registers a MENUBASE fiber on the supplied scheduler, group0/priority1000, callback2745A0, userdata+24=menu and cleanup2745B0.
claims.Limitations: The fiber may be suspended inside editor code; a trainer must not invoke its main callback directly. Static analysis; no live execution.

claims.Finding: Dispatches the menu's virtual slot+16 withRCX=menu andRDX=task. EDITBASE/GUMIEDIT/TINYEDIT resolve that slot to26CBB0.
claims.Limitations: This ABI is a fiber entry, not an ordinary one-shot command. Static analysis; no live execution.

claims.Finding: Menu task cleanup calls the owned menu deleting destructor withargument1 and clears task userdata+24.
claims.Limitations: Task removal ends editor ownership. Static analysis; no live execution.

claims.Finding: Editor exit clears active+8, removes named UI entries, stops the workarea view and marks the named work-area camera for deletion before removing its registry entry.
claims.Limitations: It invokes fiber-dependent native UI helpers; do not use as a trainer hide operation. Static analysis; no live execution.

claims.Finding: The active editor fiber enters phase1 for normal editing, phase4 for camera preview, and other phases for selection/dialog/save. It processes native commands, yields every loop, and exits when active byte+8 clears.
claims.Limitations: Safe external view actions must observe active editor plus phase1 or4 after setup; this body also writes the tutorial-progress byte and must not be replayed. Static analysis; no live execution.

claims.Finding: Editor setup installs the named UI objects, loads a supplied plan, resets its history, binds the named camera to widgets and enables regular editing.
claims.Limitations: This setup yields and depends on loaded menu resources; not an external initialization shortcut. Static analysis; no live execution.

claims.Finding: Native command dispatch maps command-kind2/subcode0 and menu71 to269B50; kind2/subcode1 and menu70 to265580. Preview entry checks camera transition flags, changes camera mode, hides named widgets and changes editor phase to4.
claims.Limitations: The complete dispatcher includes resource lists, dialogs and fiber-dependent actions; only its proven synchronous branches are candidate operations. Static analysis; no live execution.

claims.Finding: Preview exit returns the camera to mode0, restores named widgets, resets help/cost/cursor UI and puts editor phase at0 for its normal loop.
claims.Limitations: Calling28FFE0 alone would omit these editor/UI state transitions. Static analysis; no live execution.

claims.Finding: Creates a2624-byte WORKAREACAMERA, replacing any previous named object after setting its deletion flag. It schedules on151E50()->+8, i.e. global716CB8, in group0/priority65000, initializes viewport/FOV and invokes its update twice.
claims.Limitations: The camera scheduler differs from editor/workarea schedulerAF9F08. New creation is not a trainer operation. Static analysis; no live execution.

claims.Finding: Base CAMERA construction registers callback272070 with cleanup272090; task userdata+24 holds the camera and+32 is an optional pointer-to-pointer to clear. It initializes current/previous projection and view matrices.
claims.Limitations: Camera ownership must be found on the exact current scheduler; not inferred solely from its vtable. Static analysis; no live execution.

claims.Finding: The camera task checks camera flags+2352 bit1: if set it schedules task deletion; otherwise it dispatches virtual slot+8.
claims.Limitations: Reject a camera already marked for deletion even if its named registry entry still exists. Static analysis; no live execution.

claims.Finding: Camera task cleanup deletes the object and clears the optional task+32 owner pointer.26E440 passesnull for that pointer.
claims.Limitations: The registry is separately managed and must also be validated; cleanup alone does not guarantee it is cleared. Static analysis; no live execution.

claims.Finding: WORKAREACAMERA construction installs vtable5B7D48, initializes rotation/default/focus fields, calls290C60, sets remaining transition frames+2604=0 and flags+2612=4, and copies the supplied projection.
claims.Limitations: Default construction fields are not evidence that setup has finished. Static analysis; no live execution.

claims.Finding: Deleting WORKAREACAMERA destructor destroys its base camera data and frees2624 bytes through the menu allocator.
claims.Limitations: The body does not independently clear the named registry or AFBEF0 camera backlink. Static analysis; no live execution.

claims.Finding: Mode switch takesRCX=camera,DL=preview. Preview saves current Euler angles+2448 as the return baseline+2464 and FOV as+2592; leaving preview starts20 transition units, restores baseline angles/FOV and re-enables editor workarea/grid flags.
claims.Limitations: It also changes WORKAREA flags throughAFBEF0. Full preview entry/exit requires the UI/controller branches in26D620/26D450. Static analysis; no live execution.

claims.Finding: Camera input first drains remaining+2604 by an integer derived from min(frameDelta717484,2), then honors the global input lock. Preview input modifies native horizontal FOV within constants73DCC0..C4 (approximately20..90 degrees) and Euler angles; edit input starts bounded angle transitions.
claims.Limitations: Physical button naming is not established here. FOV is an angle in radians, not a camera-distance field. Static analysis; no live execution.

claims.Finding: Returns whether camera transition/lock flag+2612 contains0x20.
claims.Limitations: This predicate validates no object, scheduler or scene lifetime. Static analysis; no live execution.

claims.Finding: Native view reset takesRCX=camera andEDX=duration, stores2*duration in+2604/+2608 and sets transition flag0x10. Preview restores saved entry angles/FOV; edit mode restores native defaults and computes the cursor/grid focus. Yaw baseline is normalized in a loop by2*pi.
claims.Limitations: Ignore the incidental return value. Require finite bounded Euler values, duration>0, idle transition and valid workarea/cursor dependencies to avoid stale pointers or pathological normalization loops. Static analysis; no live execution.

claims.Finding: Initializes editor target rotation from globals73DD10..18 and derives a snapped pitch for focus calculations using73DCD8/73DCD4.
claims.Limitations: Default angles are native configuration values; no arbitrary world-camera rotation semantics are implied. Static analysis; no live execution.

claims.Finding: WORKAREACAMERA virtual update invokes2901A0, dispatches mode0 to290D50 or mode1 to2915F0, and increments+2616.
claims.Limitations: Other mode values are unsupported by this update; reject them in a trainer context. Static analysis; no live execution.

claims.Finding: Editor-mode update interpolates Euler/FOV while transition frames remain, owns the boolean input lock during transition, updates selected-cursor focus, then builds view/projection data for current and previous frames.
claims.Limitations: This routine has broad geometry/render dependencies and must remain under its native task, rather than being called after arbitrary field writes. Static analysis; no live execution.

claims.Finding: Preview-mode update interpolates only while+2604>0, releases its input-lock flag when idle, transforms the base camera around WORKAREA center and rebuilds current/previous projection matrices. An idle one-shot projection change is consumed by the next native update.
claims.Limitations: Native user zoom or reset can overwrite a one-shot trainer zoom; no persistent ownership or restoration is proposed. Static analysis; no live execution.

claims.Finding: Named-object getter calls291E20; if absent it decrements freeCount73EB50, indexes the80-entry pool at73DD90 and copies the new name after zeroing its pointer.
claims.Limitations: This is a mutating find-or-create routine with native unchecked capacity/name assumptions. Do not call it as a trainer getter. Static analysis; no live execution.

claims.Finding: Searches the80 records at73DD90..73EA10, each40 bytes with pointer+0 and name+8, skipping entries listed in free indices73EA10 using count73EB50. It returns the existing matching record ornull.
claims.Limitations: Native strlen/strcmp assume valid NUL-terminated names and a valid free list; a trainer should perform its own bounded scan. Static analysis; no live execution.

claims.Finding: Releases a named record by pushing its index onto the registry free list and clearing its pointer.
claims.Limitations: The freed record's name storage may remain; scanning names alone can find stale entries. Static analysis; no live execution.

claims.Finding: Sets globalAFD1D8=1, used by camera transitions and cursor operations as an input lock.
claims.Limitations: It is a boolean, not a reference count; external lock acquisition/release would interfere with other native owners. Static analysis; no live execution.

claims.Finding: Clears globalAFD1D8=0.
claims.Limitations: A trainer should not clear this flag to force a blocked view command. Static analysis; no live execution.

claims.Finding: Reads the currentAFD1D8 input-lock byte.
claims.Limitations: The byte alone does not identify which native operation owns the lock. Static analysis; no live execution.

claims.Finding: Reads projection FOV float atprojection+68+4*axis. Camera+16 andaxis0 thus read camera+84.
claims.Limitations: Axis bounds are caller invariants. Static analysis; no live execution.

claims.Finding: Projection setterABI isvoid(RCX=projection,XMM1=angleRadians,R8D=axis). Axis0 derives focal scale+64 and both FOVs+68/+72 from tan(angle/2), viewport dimensions+76/+80 and constants512/416.
claims.Limitations: Require finite positive viewport dimensions and bounded angle. It modifies projection data only; regular camera update builds dependent matrices. Static analysis; no live execution.

claims.Finding: Camera focus uses WORKAREA cursor+1414568 if active and cursor+2840 is nonzero; otherwise it copies workarea center+32. Active focus uses282FA0, plane selection264150 and GRID helpers24B1D0/24B220.
claims.Limitations: The edit-mode reset needs valid cursor, grid and finite vectors in addition to camera ownership. Static analysis; no live execution.

claims.Finding: Selects the focus/grid plane from cursor mode+2844 and matrix components, returning0/1/2.
claims.Limitations: The supplied matrix must be valid and finite; no resource lifetime validation occurs. Static analysis; no live execution.

claims.Finding: Selection predicate returns whether the current workarea cursor exists and lacks inactive flag4 at+16.
claims.Limitations: Nonnull alone is insufficient to access cursor data safely. Static analysis; no live execution.

claims.Finding: Builds a cursor position from actor-like fields+1072/+1120; unless flags+2976 contain4, adjusts by transformed grid-cell half extents read through currentAFBEF0.
claims.Limitations: It reads cursor data through+2976 and the current global workarea; reject stale cursor/workarea pairings. Static analysis; no live execution.

claims.Finding: Copies the grid focus vector+6072 and replaces one component using the supplied position and selected plane0/1/2 (or stored plane+6112 fornegative).
claims.Limitations: The argument is the inline GRID atWORKAREA+128, not the WORKAREA base. Static analysis; no live execution.

claims.Finding: Copies grid focus+6072 and replaces one component with grid position+6040/+6044/+6048 for the selected/stored plane.
claims.Limitations: No pointer or plane validity checks are performed. Static analysis; no live execution.

claims.Finding: Editor grid setup initializes workarea bounds/dimensions, clears linked parts, binds camera atworkarea+1414552, resets four histories and sets history cursor=-1 with zero range.
claims.Limitations: Setup assumes valid native geometry and may release/rebuild existing content; never use as a simple trainer reset. Static analysis; no live execution.

claims.Finding: Allocates a2992-byte CURSOR fromAFBA60, creates it with camera/cost context and stores it atworkarea+1414568. It starts with inactive flag4.
claims.Limitations: The cursor's allocation and resources are owned by the editor; existence is not an invitation to construct another. Static analysis; no live execution.

claims.Finding: Connects editor, workarea, named camera, embedded cost objecteditor+12016 and cursor. The current camera is stored inworkarea+1414552 and cost in+1414576; the editor material/decor mode is copied toAFBEE8.
claims.Limitations: These exact backlinks can be used in a read-only current-editor guard. Static analysis; no live execution.

claims.Finding: Begins a history transaction by incrementing current cursor+1414652 and end+1414648, retaining up tofour entries, renormalizing indices byfour, and resetting the selected history slot through its shared tail27EB00.
claims.Limitations: Complete dedicated ASM includes the noncontiguous shared tail; its41 original bytes are saved separately. Signed modulo requires valid nonnegative history indices. Static analysis; no live execution.

claims.Finding: Resets allfour history records and storesbegin=end=0,current=-1.
claims.Limitations: This discards undo history; not proposed as a harmless view action. Static analysis; no live execution.

claims.Finding: REDO wrapper computesnext=current+1; ifnext<end it storesnext and invokes27EB30 onworkarea+6256+352064*(next%4).
claims.Limitations: Corrects the old report's Undo label for27EB30. Must retain native history invariants and valid grid/resources. Static analysis; no live execution.

claims.Finding: UNDO wrapper checksbegin<=current, calls27EB70 on the current ring slot, then decrements current.
claims.Limitations: Corrects the old report's Redo label for27EB70. It can allocate/recreate parts via downstream helpers. Static analysis; no live execution.

claims.Finding: Constructs2000 snapshot records split into two1000-entry groups, clears counts+28/+32 and sets applied side+352052=1.
claims.Limitations: Snapshot handles include pointers into the current workarea; copying this object across editor lifetimes would be invalid. Static analysis; no live execution.

claims.Finding: Appends a176-byte snapshot to group0 or1 up to1000 entries, including transform, object information, flags and grid-handle pointer.
claims.Limitations: The helper only checkscount<1000, not negative counts or handle ownership. Static analysis; no live execution.

claims.Finding: Clears both group counts and sets applied side1.

claims.Finding: Removes the requested history group by dereferencing each retained grid handle, selecting material/decor mode and calling262C20 for an existing part; restoresAFBEE8 afterward.
claims.Limitations: Every handle and current part/grid relationship must still belong to the same workarea. Static analysis; no live execution.

claims.Finding: Recreates the requested history group: allocates2576-byteGUMI objects viaAFBA60, constructs from saved snapshots, inserts with267300 and restoresAFBEE8. Selection may also recolor the recreated part.
claims.Limitations: Allocator success and referenced part assets are assumed; an external undo implementation still needs complete part/resource preflight. Static analysis; no live execution.

claims.Finding: REDO-side helper removes old group0, recreates added group1 and marks side1, unless already applied.
claims.Limitations: The old gummi_controls_deep.json named this Undo-direction; group behavior was accurate but human label was reversed. Static analysis; no live execution.

claims.Finding: Part insertion withrecording enabled snapshots the added part into history group1. It updates cost, grid occupancy and the packed-pointer linked part list, supporting the corrected redo/undo interpretation.

claims.Finding: Bulk part removal withrecording enabled snapshots removed parts into group0; it updates cost, invokes part cleanup, unlinks packed-pointer list entries and clears grid ownership cells.

claims.Finding: Part removal derives occupied grid cells from native part dimensions/transforms and routes each through263010 while temporarily selecting the appropriate material/decor mode.
claims.Limitations: Division by cell dimensions, float-to-int conversion and grid indices require valid geometry; this is an unresolved undo preflight dependency. Static analysis; no live execution.

claims.Finding: Returns current editor globalAFC118.

claims.Limitations: No exporter or filesystem operation was executed. The old internal destination and downstream transport are not proposed as a user-facing trainer operation. Static analysis; no live execution.
